reviews.title: Great all around headset!
reviews.comment:
As a audiophile I wasn’t sure what to expect especially after doing research and reading so many varied reviews so here my honest opinion from various use (mostly music and for work/phone calls all day).
Arrived fully charged and was super easy to setup.
Just know they are “only” wireless and no backup 3.5mm or USB audio connection (can only charge and no audio connection which is a flaw in my opinion).
They are very nice quality and pretty much resemble airline/cockpit cans/headsets, lol.
They don’t save your height/adjustments but are on smooth arms along each side and very easy to adjust.
I wouldn’t say they are light nor heavy either so a very good balance. Maybe a bit tight grip over the ears but not enough to be a bother. So you are able to wear them all day for work, like I do, and are very comfortable.
The mic is one of the best there is (it’s between these and the Beyerdynamic MMX300), and just great quality.
As for audio quality they are good but not great (the Beyerdynamic ones are way better but missing crucial feature like the app/eq control).
They have good top end and highs but seriously lacking in the lows (as expected with Bluetooth/wireless only connections) so just know that going into it.
And one of their best features is the app/software and being able to fine tune both the listening eq as well as the mic eq, adjust the volume of hearing yourself in the mix, and see status/battery levels…All of which are missing from others that might have better audio quality but missing all of those extra features (looking at you Beyerdynamic, lol).
So if you don’t need high resolution/high fidelity then these are just about the best there is right now.
